# ex: needParen when binary expr replaces index base position
ex {
	var s []int
	var i int
	s[i] -> s[i+1]
}
-- x.go --
package m

func F(s []int) int {
	return s[0]
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -1,5 +1,5 @@
 package m

 func F(s []int) int {
-	return s[0]
+	return s[0+1]
 }
